audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty verdict is right but never grounded in Mel's actual kit.
audit.why: 61.5% win rate over 1992 games, FAVOURED, 4/10. Mel has no dash (kit lists no dash flag) and Fizz's Playful/Trickster (E) is untargetable, so her only lane-defining tool is Solar Snare (E) at 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Early is a poke lane; mid and side lane are Fizz's; teamfights favour Fizz because she is a stationary caster; snowball is high because a single Solar Snare miss ends her.
audit.corrected: Kept 4/10 FAVOURED; regrounded early/mid text on Solar Snare and Rebuttal instead of generic 'his CC'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text never mentions Overwhelm or Golden Eclipse's stack-scaling.
audit.why: Fizz spikes at 3 (Playful/Trickster), 6 (Chum the Waters), first item, then two items. Mel's counter-spike is Rebuttal (W) at 38s rank 1 falling to 26s at rank 5, and Golden Eclipse (R, 120/100/80s) which strikes at 25000 range for damage per Overwhelm stack. That is the spike that changes how you take chip damage.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names Golden Eclipse and Overwhelm stack tracking; breakdown.spikes left, it was already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup was never stated: Chum the Waters is a projectile and Rebuttal reflects projectiles back at the attacker.
audit.why: Fizz R carries the projectile flag; Mel W text reads that the barrier 'reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage'. Fizz Q (Urchin Strike) is a dash, not a projectile, so it is not reflected. Playful/Trickster grants untargetability, which is the answer to Solar Snare's root. Fizz's passive lets him walk through minions, so her Radiant Volley zone and minion-line poke are easier to path around.
audit.corrected: Stated explicitly in tldr, breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns and loading: never shark into Rebuttal; pole Solar Snare, not Radiant Volley.

notes:
Decisive interaction added: Fizz R (Chum the Waters) carries the projectile flag and Mel's Rebuttal reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker — this was completely absent from the page and is the reason the matchup is ever losable. Fizz Q is a dash, not a projectile, so it is unaffected. Level chart is all Fizz on both layers and matches the packet and the 61.5% win rate, so no side/win pairs were moved. Lint had four MISGENDER hits inside report[] (0, 3, 4, 9); the sweep caps report rewrites at two, so report[0].t and report[3].t were rewritten and report[4].t / report[9].t were left — their 'his tower' and 'make him flinch' pronouns are still wrong and need a mechanical pronoun pass. UNVERIFIED and therefore not written: whether Playful/Trickster's untargetability dodges Golden Eclipse (Mel R does not target, it strikes all Overwhelm-marked enemies), and whether Rebuttal's reflected Chum the Waters can attach to Fizz himself.
